title: Harrier Configuration
description: Optional configuration file for Harrier code review engine (harrier.config.json or .harrier.json)

categories.description: Limit review to these categories only

minSeverity.description: Minimum severity to include in the final report

outDir.description: Directory where report files (json, sarif, md, html) will be written

useLlm.description: Whether to run semantic LLM passes

endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 or https://openrouter.ai/api/v1)

model.description: LLM model identifier to use for structure, quality, bug passes and verifier

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for scanner executions and API requests

offline.description: When true, no outgoing network calls are permitted

instructions.description: Plain English instructions and architectural guidelines for the reviewer

custom.description: List of explicit custom rules written in plain English
